name: Continua
source:
Emma calls you. She wants you to come over, because she feels unsafe.

While you try to prevent a death, you are stuck in a time loop. Every decision matters as you solve the circumstances of the murder case and uncover the mystery of the time loop.
translation:
艾玛打电话给你。她想让你过来，因为她觉得不安全。

当你试图阻止死亡时，你却陷入了时间循环。当你解决谋杀案的情况并揭开时间循环之谜时，每一个决定都很重要。
